name: Wolf
identity: Compact shaggy gray-brown and olive-brown wolf, warm ochre round spots on forehead, cheeks, shoulders, flank and tail. Slate-gray face and back fur highlights over darker olive-brown base, jagged cheek and back fur, two large pointed ears with tan inner pads on FRONT ONLY. Large ivory-white eyes with small black pupils and white highlights, thick dark brown angular brows, broad dark brown nose with tan highlight, cream mouth and prominent cream fangs. Small light gray/cream chest fur tuft ONLY under the front neck. Four short sturdy canine legs with rounded paws and subtle toe lines, long broad crescent-curved gray/brown bushy tail with an ochre patch. No collar, saddle, armor, horns, rider, separate dorsal spikes, white winter coat or invented equipment.

source_review.findings: Own full atlas and serialized complete source viewed. Gray/olive brown broad color blocks and ochre spots; ivory eyes and fangs, two tall ears; lighter chest tuft; seven visible non-shadow renderers, one head, torso, four short legs, broad curved tail.
